# dependent -> prerequisite  (sections and edges alphabetical)

# dep
dep -> dep_install
dep_configure -> base_install

# file-to-component
payload-lib -> payload-lib_install
payload-lib_configure -> payload_unpack

# link-component
link-b -> link-b_install
link-b_configure -> link-a_install

# meta
meta-inner_install -> leaf-a_install
meta-inner_install -> leaf-b_install
meta-plugins_install -> leaf-a_install
meta-plugins_install -> leaf-b_install
meta-tc_install -> mtc-inherit_install
meta-tc_install -> mtc-pinned_install

# order-independent
second -> second_install
second_configure -> first_install

# prerequisite
prereq-lib -> prereq-lib_install
prereq-lib_configure -> prereq_touch

# sdkloader
sdkloader -> sdkloader_install
sdkloader_configure -> sdk-headers_install

# slow-configure
slow-configure -> slow-configure_install
slow-configure_configure -> base_install
